# Paramount Concrete & Hardscapes

> Concrete and hardscape contractor serving Knoxville and East Tennessee (roughly a 35-mile radius). Family-owned since 2018. Driveways, patios, stamped concrete, pavers, retaining walls, walkways, steps and fire pits — built for East Tennessee's clay soil and freeze-thaw winters. Every project starts with a free phone consultation.

- Phone: (865) 237-9770
- Email: j.paramountservices@gmail.com
- Location: 1201 Bob Kirby Rd, Knoxville, TN 37932
- Rating: 5.0 stars

## Services
- [Concrete](https://paramountknox.com/concrete/): driveways, patios, stamped & decorative, sidewalks & walkways, slabs, pool decks
- [Pavers](https://paramountknox.com/pavers/): patios, driveways, walkways, pool decks (Belgard, Techo-Bloc, Regal)
- [Retaining Walls](https://paramountknox.com/retaining-walls/): segmental block and natural stone, with drainage and engineering when height requires
- [Hardscapes](https://paramountknox.com/hardscapes/): fire pits, walkways & steps, outdoor living

## Pricing (Knoxville, TN, installed)
- Concrete: ~$10–$12/sq ft broom or troweled; ~$18–$20/sq ft stamped or stained
- Paver patios: ~$25–$35/sq ft; paver driveways: ~$45–$55/sq ft
- Retaining walls: start around $48 up to $65+ per face sq ft
- Walkways and steps are priced by the project, not per square foot

Knoxville, West Knoxville, Farragut, Maryville, Alcoa, Louisville, Oak Ridge, Clinton, Powell, Sevierville, Lenoir City, Seymour, Karns — and surrounding East Tennessee communities.
